name: Jean-Marc Germain, Monika Hohlmeier - Après le considérant G - Am 5
title: REPORT on the implementation of the rule of law conditionality regime
part_text: Ga. whereas the former Commissioner entrusted with negotiating the anti-corruption framework for the rule of law reports is currently under investigation for money laundering and other corruption-related offences; whereas the non-governmental organisations (NGOs) taking part in the Commission’s annual rule of law report procedures were directly funded by the Commission and governments outside the EU; whereas the objectivity and impartiality of these reports are highly questionable;
